# DevLab 1.0 workspace compatibility baseline

This fixture is the minimum durable workspace representation supported by
DevLab 1.x. It is intentionally committed rather than generated from current
writers: changing an incompatible reader or format must break the focused
compatibility tests.

The fixture represents a planned milestone with one eligible task and includes
examples of the extensible tracker formats, a completed research record, an
answered clarification, structured historical session evidence, and an
archived planning-generation manifest.
